scope: Current overview and references for the accepted 180-component collection; detailed inventories are stored once in SOURCES/core_catalog and primary group reports.
measurement_rules: Bytes mean regular-file bytes, not filesystem blocks.
Original downloaded source, retained source, static archive container, text/data/bss, final executable and peak RAM are different measurements.
Do not add build/install duplicates, intermediate combined archives or alternate decode-only providers to the selected production footprint.
MPI runtime, platform SDKs and other external dependencies are accounted for separately.
Large broad libraries and explicitly accepted scientific libraries are not rejected by a 1 MB gate in this snapshot.

production_static_archives.contains: Exact selected archive paths, bytes and hashes, exclusions and strong-symbol comparison.
production_static_archives.measurement_scope: Observed full composition archives; sum is not linked LMX size.

final_linked_lmx_binary.reason: The deliverable is a source patch and integration/catalog guide, not a final LMX executable.

peak_runtime_memory.reason: Requires a concrete target platform, actor workload and selected mutable native contexts.

actor_storage: independent: immutable: CODE/DATA are shared by references; no copies of these objects are allocated in each actor arena.
